title: Write-Down of Carrier-Declined Lines on Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
A line the carrier declines is recorded on the Insurance Claim Services claim file as a carrier denied line write-off, and on an arrangement that never bills declined lines to the customer it is written down on the Mold Remediation job.

**Declined-line write-down.** When no water, fire, rebuild or contents job is linked to the same claim file, the declined-line write-down is the whole total of the claim file's carrier denied line write-offs; when a job of one of those categories is linked to it, the declined-line write-down is that total times the fraction of the mold-covered total over the claim file's estimate amount, the fraction never taken above 1, rounded to the cent, half up, and the whole total when the estimate amount is 0.00; on every other arrangement there is no declined-line write-down.

**Credited value recorded as a declined line.** On a claim file whose arrangement never bills declined lines to the customer, when a Water Damage Mitigation job or Reconstruction contract linked to the same claim file carries a billing error, duplicate line or goodwill credit or a change order credit, a carrier denied line write-off on the file may record value that job already credited rather than a line the carrier declined, and a request to pay the insured's own share of the Mold Remediation job is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

The mold-covered total is the Mold Remediation job's remediation scope, equipment day and clearance fee lines as booked. The other categories are jobs or contracts of Water Damage Mitigation, Fire & Smoke Mitigation, Reconstruction or Contents Packout & Storage linked to the same claim file.

| Arrangement never bills declined lines | Other job linked to the claim file | Estimate amount | Write-down |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Any | The whole total of carrier denied line write-offs |
| Yes | Yes | Above 0.00 | That total times the mold-covered total over the estimate amount (at most 1), rounded to the cent, half up |
| Yes | Yes | 0.00 | The whole total |
| No | — | — | None |

Hypothetical: carrier denied line write-offs of 900.00 on a file with an estimate amount of 24000.00 and a water job linked to it; the mold job's mold-covered total is 6000.00. The fraction is 6000.00 over 24000.00, which is 0.25, and the write-down is 225.00. Had the mold-covered total exceeded 24000.00, the fraction would be held at 1 and the write-down would be 900.00.
